claims.natural_statement: For p>S, Phi_(p,t)=0 for t=1,2,3 implies only a common entry step and alpha=beta+gamma. At any chosen entry step, aligned factors with Y+r=p^2, L-u=pk, and Y+L+d=p(p+k) realize the exact split (alpha,beta,gamma)=(2,1,1), so complete balance need not be one-sided; the raw template admits both Y/L tending to 2 and Y/L tending to infinity with S tending to infinity and S/L tending to zero. Concrete p=127 and p=50021 legal three-block controls also satisfy increasing slopes, every exact two-sided slope window, and strict mean inequalities while exhibiting the split, but have other p>S mismatches and fail all original products. Thus indivisible one-side factor matching and its quotient-multiplier lattice do not follow from complete valuations; the full coupled all-p allocation problem remains open.

For every legal three-block integer tuple and every prime p>S, vanishing of Phi_(p,t) at all three prefixes gives one common entry step and exactly one of three allocation types: a middle-low match with equal valuations, a middle-high match with equal valuations, or a two-sided aligned split with r=u+d and valuations (2e,e,e). Consequently, complete balance for all p>S forces every prime divisor of product_(r=1)^S(Y+r) to be at most L+S and is equivalent to equality of the S-rough parts of binomial(Y+L,L) and binomial(Y+L+B_t,L-H_t) for t=1,2,3; each endpoint divisibility Y+S_t | L!/(L-S_t)! forbids a two-sided split at r=S_t. Moreover every unbounded sequence with Y/L->infinity, S/L->0, strict increasing block slopes, and all reviewed two-sided slope windows eventually satisfies Y*log(Y/L)<=80*S^3. These are necessary conditions only: they neither construct a complete all-p>S balanced family nor force a mismatch, so the global split-balance dichotomy remains open.

For every unbounded legal three-block sequence with S tending to infinity, S/L tending to zero, Y/L tending to infinity, the reviewed S-rough binomial equalities, and Y*log(Y/L)<=80*S^3 eventually, every sufficiently large member has a prefix t in {1,2,3} and a prime S/3<p<=S for which the Kummer total carry counts of C(Y+L,L) and C(Y+L+D_t,L-H_t) differ, or, after their common p-power is removed, their normalized p-adic units differ modulo p^2. Hence no unbounded exact common-anchor chain survives this branch. The isolated band S/2<p<=S is not claimed sufficient, the finite common-anchor residual is not enumerated, and no multiplicity counterexample is produced.

For every unbounded legal three-block sequence with S tending to infinity, S/L tending to zero, Y/L tending to infinity, the reviewed S-rough binomial equalities, and Y*log(Y/L)<=80*S^3 eventually, every sufficiently large member has a prefix t in {1,2,3} and a prime S/3<p<=S for which the Kummer total carry counts of C(Y+L,L) and C(Y+L+D_t,L-H_t) differ, or, after their common p-power is removed, their normalized p-adic units differ modulo p^2. claims.natural_statement: For every legal common-anchor tuple with K>=10, K<=y<K^2, and every prime K/2<p<=K, the complete Kummer valuation uses only the p and p^2 interval crossings and the Granville normalized unit is the corresponding p-free interval product modulo p^2. For each prefix t, simultaneous valuation and unit agreement throughout the band is exactly M_K | (u_t-v_t), where u_t/v_t is the reduced original product ratio and M_K=product_(K/2<p<=K)p^2. The cumulative-prefix to successive-block fingerprint map has unimodular exponent matrix, so eliminating one-row states yields exactly the three finite-quotient images of the original product equations and no additional cross-prefix relation. This is a restatement boundary, not a common-anchor exclusion, a legal arbitrary-K neutralizing family, or a multiplicity counterexample.

For every integer K>=10 and real y>=K, the Gamma continuation of the common-anchor equation is a unique smooth graph d=f(h) on its triangular zero arc, with f''(h)>2/(K-h)>2/K including both endpoints. Three integer graph points have positive integral area Delta and f''(xi)=2Delta/[a*c*(a+c)], while the sharp domain-only threshold is L_K=2/[(K-5)floor((K-5)^2/4)]<2/K. Hence the global curvature-versus-domain-only-lattice-area mechanism cannot exclude three zeros without an additional arithmetic localization theorem.

For the fixed slope-compatible cumulative pairs (h,d)=(2,1),(3,3),(4,8), let D(K,y) be the determinant of the three complete logarithmic factorial-sum columns U_(h+d), V_h, W_d. For every integer K>=2^20, D(K,K)>0 and D(K,K^2-K)<0, so D vanishes at a real y in (K,K^2-K). Thus the canonical complete factorial-ratio secant determinant has no parameter-uniform fixed sign or nonvanishing property on the full admissible domain; this does not give integer zeros of the original equations.

For every integer K>=10 and real y>=K, the Gamma continuation of the common-anchor equation is a unique smooth graph d=f(h) on its triangular zero arc, with f''(h)>2/(K-h)>2/K including both endpoints. Three integer graph points have positive integral area Delta and f''(xi)=2Delta/[a*c*(a+c)]. The sharp domain-only threshold is 2/Q_K, where Q_K=(K-5)floor((K-5)^2/4) for even K and Q_K=(K-6)floor((K-6)^2/4) for odd K, and 2/Q_K<2/K. For the fixed slope-compatible cumulative pairs (h,d)=(2,1),(3,3),(4,8), let D(K,y) be the determinant of the three complete logarithmic factorial-sum columns U_(h+d), V_h, W_d. For every integer K>=2^20, D(K,K)>0 and D(K,K^2-K)<0, so D vanishes at a real y in (K,K^2-K). Thus the canonical determinant has no parameter-uniform fixed sign and is not nonvanishing on the real Gamma-continued domain. This does not establish vanishing or nonvanishing at integer y and does not give integer zeros of the original equations.

For y=K, every integer K>=64 divisible by 16 has three exact real Gamma-zero points at h=K/16,K/8,3K/16 inside the triangular arc, and their oriented secant area exceeds K^2/2048>=2. Hence the complete real zero equation cannot uniformly force every three-point area below the integer lattice unit without new integrality or arithmetic input. In addition, for the fixed slope-compatible integer pairs (h,d)=(2,1),(3,3),(4,8), the canonical complete factorial-log determinant is positive at y=K and negative at y=K^2-K for every K>=2^20; it has no parameter-uniform fixed sign and vanishes at an intermediate real y. Neither statement establishes an integer-y determinant zero or integer zeros of the original products.

For every legal common-anchor triple, if the three monic factorial polynomials share an integer root y, then their integer polynomial ideal has zero intersection with the nonzero integers and every polynomial subresultant retains Y-y. For every integer y, complete synthetic division of each polynomial is already integral before the root remainder is set to zero, and the full quotient system is triangularly equivalent to the three original evaluations and block products. The strict-slope cumulative family n(5,2), n(7,4), n(8,8) also makes all three scaled limiting polynomials share X^2+X+1 on a legal compact-ratio S=o(K) geometry. Hence primitive-subresultant/Bezout gaps and complete synthetic division integrality alone do not exclude the unbounded bounded-ratio class; the exact-chain objective remains open and no integer counterexample is produced.

Among legal common-anchor scaled polynomials, every zero-order gcd for unequal cumulative slopes is either 1 or Phi_3; Phi_3 occurs exactly when d is even and h-d is divisible by 3 for both pairs, and it is simple. For n(5,2), n(7,4), n(8,8), the first u-remainder modulo Phi_3 is nonzero and the cyclotomic velocities split. Nevertheless, a determinant-one Fibonacci growing legal geometry has zero-order gcd 1 while its first two exact real scaled polynomials share a positive real root at u_m with S_m^2 u_m tending to 0. The u_m are not proved reciprocal integers and the roots are not proved rational, so the exact integer chain and multiplicity counterexample remains open; this refutes only continuous cyclotomic-deformation/resultant square-root nonvanishing and does not improve the existing cube-root scale.

For q_m=F_(2m), r_m=F_(2m+1), and cumulative pairs (r_m,q_m), (r_m+q_m,r_m), (r_m+q_m+1,r_m+1), no integers K>q_m+2r_m+2 and K<=y<K^2 satisfy all three exact common-anchor product equations. More generally, for every fixed m>=1, infinitely many ell=4h+2 admit the floor-defined nested legal pair satisfying the joint directed source condition product_(i=1)^m (T+i)(H-i) | product_(r=1)^(a+b)(X-r), with a distinct full-multiplicity source allocation. Requiring exact all-depth source balance is equivalent to the original equation R(a,b)=1. Hence no fixed-depth or noncircular exact-completion source-resultant obstruction excludes the terminal-unit branch.

For the terminal Fibonacci state, the ell=6 nested lattice points (2693,2297) and (2772,2336) satisfy the complete simultaneous oriented i=1,2 prime-power source condition but fail both original products modulo 40009. Exact equality of every full-depth source and target valuation is the original equation R(a,b)=1. These facts retire only a uniform fixed-depth joint-source obstruction: they do not decide strict point-dependent divisibility W_(a,b) | L_(a+b), do not provide a depth growing with ell, and do not retire the growing source-depth route.

claims.natural_statement: For the globally soluble nonzero D_(25,2) theta [2]-cover of C:(T-1)(T-9)(T-25)=384u(u^2-1)(u^2-4), the 256-point pole fiber has affine monodromy (F_2)^8 semidirect O_8^+(2). The least number-field degree over which this fiber splits is 240, where it has two degree-128 orbits. For every number field K/Q, its number r_K of K-irreducible pole components satisfies r_K<=|S_infinity(K)|<=|S_K|. Thus no finite base extension restores Levin's strict direct Runge condition. This completes only extension stability; complete true/fake descent, all local Kummer images, the exhaustive survivor list, uniform integral lifting, and campaign point classification remain open.

For the (5,6) genus-4 curve, an exact true/fake theta [2]-descent computes the global square-class and class-group contributions, the fake-to-true kernel, every bad and archimedean local Kummer image, and the complete everywhere-locally-soluble twist table; it includes a campaign-compatible survivor and proves one uniform finite S for all campaign integral lifts. This remains open.

Therefore the complete fake local Kummer image has dimension 3 and the local true-to-fake kernel has dimension 1.

Indeed all prime-power source inequalities make R=L/W a positive integer, while the full logarithmic band gives abs(log R)<log 2. For every legal pair one also has 0<R<(B/A)^(a-b). Thus the universal missing-source statement on the thin band is exactly the still-open thin-band zero-exclusion statement; neither statement is proved by this rigidity result.

For ell>=2, set A=F_(2ell-1), B=F_(2ell), X=B^2, T=AB, H=X+T and t_ell=binomial(H-1,T). Every legal integer pair a>b>=1 with 2a+b<=A^2-2 has R(a,b)=binomial(H-1-b,T+a)/t_ell, and binomial(H,T-1)=t_ell. If two such points (a,b)<(c,e) are strictly nested coordinatewise and both have R=1, the four distinct cells (H,T-1), (H-1,T), (H-1-b,T+a), (H-1-e,T+c) represent t_ell; every cell satisfies n>=2T and n/4<=m<=n/2. Also T>=4^(ell-1) and t_ell>=2^T.

For every integer ell>=ell_*, with A=F_(2ell-1), B=F_(2ell), X=B^2, T=AB, H=X+T and R as in research/common_anchor_terminal_unit_thin_source_capacity.md, there are no strictly coordinatewise nested legal integer points (a,b)<(c,e) with a>b>=1, c>e>=1, 2a+b<=A^2-2, 2c+e<=A^2-2 and R(a,b)=R(c,e)=1. In particular no such pair exists anywhere in the complete thin band B_ell. This is a terminal specialization of the already independently reviewed explicit MRSTT interior theorem, not a new logarithmic-separation theorem, a small-index exclusion, or a multiplicity counterexample.

claims.natural_statement: The exact theta-compatible 2-adic torsion image and full affine Kummer image for the explicit genus-four C,J,D_(25,2), together with the all-level all-number-field direct-Runge obstruction, constitute an original arithmetic theorem with a nontrivial technical core and publishable mathematical significance. This is the publication acceptance obligation, not a consequence of the already verified mathematical proof or of a source-search absence.

The square-map character determined by q on Pi/(Pi^4[Pi,Pi]^2[[Pi,Pi],Pi]), with closed generated subgroups, respects the genus-four surface relation and has G_Q-stable kernel. It constructs a geometrically connected smooth projective finite etale cover Z->C over Q of degree512 and genus1537, with rational P0-lift, geometric deck group E, and central quotient the pointed cover Y1. Its512 infinity points are all order-three u-poles.

For the actual pointed quotient E, the based G_Q action has image Aut(E), not a hypothesized maximal image: irreducibility of V and Griess nonsplitting force this from the reviewed full O_8^+(2) residue image. Moreover End_O(V)=F_2 and H^1(Aut(E),V)=0, by the same nonsplitting and the reviewed finite H^1(O,V)=0.

The actual G_Q permutation image on the512-point infinity fiber of Z is the full Hol(E)=E semidirect Aut(E). The mod-center path cocycle is the nonzero Kummer class of -D, and H^1(Aut(E),V)=0 plus the extraspecial Frattini property forces the entire nonabelian translation subgroup E.

Every proper subgroup H of Hol(E), in the natural512-point action on E, has at most [Hol(E):H]/2 orbits. The proof covers all subgroups by double cosets; a singleton Aut(E)-orbit on H\Hol(E) forces H, after conjugacy, to be Aut(E) or Z(E) semidirect Aut(E), giving respectively four or three orbits at indices512 or256.

There exists the actual pointed Q-descended degree512 extraspecial cover Z->C with central quotient Y1, full based automorphism image Aut(E) and full infinity-fiber image Hol(E). For every number field K, r_Z(K)<=r_1(K)+r_2(K), so no finite extension restores the strict direct-Runge condition for u on this nonabelian cover. This is a new nonabelian arithmetic conclusion relative to the accepted abelian tower, not a K(a)>=9, complete Selmer, integral-point classification, verified-priority or publishability claim.

For symmetric L, Mumford constructs eta_2:G(L^2)->G(L), squaring scalars. An order-two lift above v in A[2] maps under eta_2 to e_*^L(v), whose polarization is the Weil commutator.
